Stories discussed in today's episode:

  • Apple reports Q3 2026 earnings: $109.4 billion in revenue, up 16% year-over-year
  • Apple stock opens down about 10% on mixed Q3 2026 results
  • Apple warns supply constraints will 'significantly worsen' next quarter
  • Tim Cook hosts his final earnings call, confirming Ternus will take over future calls
  • App Store regulatory changes begin impacting Apple Services growth
  • Apple's latest acquisition is a big win for its product roadmap
